svg.title: Certificate Management: Stored Objects, Ownership, and Lifetime

g.text: Certificate Management: Stored Objects, Ownership, and Lifetime

g.id: cluster_Per client (released with the client's node)
g.text: Per client (released with the client's node)
Caches slot content: the certificate and the CRL snapshot are held
weakly, the CRL state strongly. A write through the daemon
invalidates the slot's certificate and CRL entries and advances
their generations, so a load that overlapped its own invalidation
Holds strong references to the CertObject and CrlData snapshots of
its enabled members, the same objects the slot manager hands out.
The set is filtered by member enablement and, for conditional
members, by the accepted fingerprint. The references are released
when no client holds the store (per-client reference counts).
Per-client state attaches here. The CertObject it wraps is
shared with every other reader of the slot; the session CRL
is visible only through this entry.
Per client; released with the client's node
